_comment: Pillar 6 'Cross-border data policies' per-indicator vocabulary, seeded from the RDTII 2.1 indicator definitions (RDTII 2.1 Guide) with Malay variants for the Malaysian corpus. Used by the M5 indicator gate (bm25s) and the M10/M11 keyword prefilter. Keys are the OFFICIAL indicator titles' canonical numeric IDs. _pillar_description feeds the M5 pillar gate (BGE-M3 cosine). 5 Jul 2026 (M11 calibration): added the English hold/take-records-outside localization phrasings ('outside Singapore', 'outside Australia', 'records outside', 'held outside', 'hold the records') - the canonical statutory wording of 6.1/6.2 measures (e.g. My Health Records Act 2012 s.77), parallel to the pre-existing Malay 'di luar Malaysia'. M5 fixture recall re-verified after the change.
_pillar_description: Cross-border data policies: bans or local-processing requirements for transferring data abroad, local storage requirements, local infrastructure or data-centre requirements, and conditional flow regimes such as consent or adequacy conditions on cross-border data transfer.
6.2: kept at a place in Singapore
